question: Rebarboru pečieme do sladkých koláčov ako ovocie, no v skutočnosti je to zelenina. Ktorú časť rastliny z nej jeme?
source_excerpt: The edible part of rhubarb is the leaf stalk, or petiole, and the leaves are toxic.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks bake rebarbora into sweet cakes and treat it as fruit, but it is a vegetable, and the part they eat is a leaf stalk. The leaves are poisonous. The player can reason it out from picturing the plant.
extra.verification_notes: Rhubarb's edible part is the leaf stalk (petiole) and the leaf blades are toxic; the extension and Wikipedia pages I found agree (https://extension.oregonstate.edu/catalog/pub/ec-797-grow-your-own-rhubarb).

explanation: Jeme dužinaté listové stopky, a listy sa vyhadzujú dobrým dôvodom: majú toľko kyseliny šťaveľovej, že sú jedovaté.

question: Na povrchu jahody sedia drobné žlté zrniečka, ktorým takmer každý hovorí semienka. Čím sú však podľa botanikov naozaj?
source_excerpt: each one is its own dry fruit containing a single seed

extra.why_interesting: Everyone calls the specks on a strawberry seeds, but each one is actually a separate little fruit. That means a strawberry is a cluster of about two hundred fruits sitting on a swollen flower base. The stem hints that 'seeds' is wrong, so the player can reason toward the answer.
extra.verification_notes: The dots on a strawberry are achenes, which are true dry fruits each holding one seed, so 'plody' is correct (https://www.livescience.com/planet-earth/plants/why-do-strawberries-have-seeds-on-the-outside).

explanation: Každé zrniečko je samostatný plodík, nažka, so semenom vo vnútri. Červená sladká dužina je iba zdurené kvetné lôžko, takže jahoda vlastne nie je jeden plod, ale celá kôpka plodov.
